parsed.rationale: The eight participating records span four unrelated packages (Playback, DebugPanel, Wallpaper, Intents) and cover entirely unrelated domain types: IntentError, PlaybackError, PlaybackState, PlayerState, StreamingAudioState, TimeoutError, and two separate ProcessInfo.ThermalState extensions. All members carry empty fields_or_signature arrays, meaning the only shared 'shape' is that each is an empty or near-empty extension or type-alias-object — a structural coincidence with no semantic content to consolidate. The structural_evidence confirms this: differing_slots and jaccard are both null, and shared_field_count is merely 1 with nothing substantive in common. Merging or extracting across these unrelated domain boundaries would create artificial coupling between packages that have no business relationship.
